title: North Korean Soccer Players Visit South Korea for First Time in 7+ Years
detail: Thirty-nine players and staff from Pyongyang's Naegohyang Women's Football Club arrived in South Korea for the Asian club championship — the first visit by North Korean athletes to the South in over seven years. The unprecedented inter-Korean exchange aligns with President Lee Jae-myung's policy of incremental engagement and de-escalation, seeking to restore people-to-people contact that had been suspended since 2019. The visit is a significant symbolic gesture following North Korea's March 2026 constitutional revision codifying permanent two-state separation.

media.caption: North Korean women's football team arrives in South Korea — first DPRK athletes to visit in 7 years
